request: Pull federal contract awards (award type A/B/C/D = definitive contracts and BPA/IDV variants) from USAspending.gov for the first half of 2025, enrich with NAICS code+description flattening, days_active = end_date - start_date, and trend analysis by Awarding Agency + NAICS code. Publish to 'Prep Agent / 10 - Federal Contract Awards' on Tableau Server for procurement analysts.

sources.name: USAspending Contract Awards H1 2025
sources.description: USAspending.gov spending_by_award API. Each row = one federal contract action posted between 2025-01-01 and 2025-06-30. Award type codes A/B/C/D cover BPA Calls, Purchase Orders, Delivery Orders, and Definitive Contracts. Public, keyless. POST + JSON body; pagination uses 'page' field in body with hasNext termination signal.

fields: Period of Performance Current End Date

args.name: Award Trend
args.features_description: Adds row-level temporal features parsed from Start Date (year, month, quarter, day_of_week, iso_week). Pure pass-through of USAspending contract award rows.
args.stats_description: Long-form federal contract award statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month over Awarding Agency and NAICS code). Includes monthly_count, 30-day rolling counts, year-over-year deltas + pct change (limited use here since the demo window is six months), z-score anomalies vs baseline (|z|>=2.0 flagged is_anomaly=True), lifetime rank/pct_of_total. Use to identify agencies with surging award volume or unusual NAICS-code concentrations.

outputs.name: Federal Award Detail
outputs.description: Row-level federal contract awards from USAspending.gov for the first half of 2025. Includes Award ID, Recipient Name, Awarding Agency + Sub Agency, Award Amount (USD), Start/End dates, Description, naics_code + naics_description (flattened from the API's nested NAICS object), days_of_performance (End - Start), Place of Performance State Code. Plus calendar features. Source: api.usaspending.gov/api/v2/search/spending_by_award. Refresh: monthly.

outputs.name: Federal Award Stats
outputs.description: Long-form federal contract award statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month over Awarding Agency and naics_code). Includes 30-day rolling counts, year-over-year deltas + pct change, z-score anomalies vs baseline (|z|>=2.0 flagged is_anomaly=True), lifetime rank/pct_of_total. Joinable from Tableau on (dimension, value, year, month). Source: USAspending.gov.
